name: Polycab India

headline.text: Q2 FY27: revenue ₹9,899 cr (+52.8% YoY), PAT ₹990 cr (+42.9% YoY).
Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹34,609 cr, EBITDA ₹4,686 cr (13.5% margin), PAT ₹3,202 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 26.9% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹8,792 cr → ₹28,884 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 28.9% was within its 5-year range (15.6% to 38.8%).
EBITDA margin expanded by 83 bps over FY23–FY26 (13.1% → 13.9%).
PAT compounded at 25.0% a year over FY21–FY26, in line with revenue.
Debt-to-equity was 0.02 at FY27 end (0.02 at FY24).
Borrowings rose 1.7× from ₹161 cr to ₹272 cr over FY24–FY27.
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow was 1.01× reported profit (₹8,856 cr vs ₹8,756 cr) — profits are turning into cash.

citations.section: Operating cash flow FY26 not located on a page

claims.text: Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 4 of the last 5 years, ₹4,592 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹4,264 cr, 48% of operating cash flow (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle shortened from 65 to 39 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 33% in FY26 (27% in FY23).
